<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="PUT" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/auto_topup"}
#docs
Buys credit when the live balance is at or below `threshold_minor`, or on a schedule. `fixed` buys `amount_minor` (a multiple of it, so the balance lands above the threshold); `target` buys up to `target_minor`. Each run stays inside the business's top-up limits, the monthly cap and `max_runs_per_day`; on an INR card or UPI mandate a run is at most ₹15,000. Credit is granted only when the purchase invoice is paid. A decline voids the invoice and turns automatic top-up off. On a payment method that needs an advance notice, a threshold below the notice lead's usage at the current rate is refused. Needs `usage_controls:manage`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` | no | ISO currency. Default: the credit unit's, else the customer's. |
| `unit` | `string` | no | The credit unit's id. Null or absent = money credit. |
| `trigger` | `string` | **yes** | What started the auto topup input. One of `threshold`, `schedule`. |
| `threshold_minor` | `integer` | no | Buy when the live balance is at or below this. |
| `schedule` | `object` | no | `{every: week, weekday: 1–7}` (ISO, 1 = Monday) or `{every: month, day: 1–31}`. A day past the month's end runs on its last day. |
| `method` | `string` | **yes** | The method. One of `fixed`, `target`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | no | `fixed`: the amount to buy. |
| `target_minor` | `integer` | no | `target`: buy up to this balance. |
| `monthly_cap_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | Most that runs can buy per calendar month. |
| `max_runs_per_day` | `integer` | no | 1 to 10. Default 3. |
| `payment_method` | `string` | no | The `pm_…` to charge. Null = the customer's charge order. |
| `grant` | `object` | **yes** | The credit each run buys. |
| `grant.tax_treatment` | `string` | **yes** | The grant's tax treatment. One of `taxed_at_purchase`, `taxed_at_use`. |
| `grant.priority` | `integer` | no | Lower draws first. 0 to 100. |
| `grant.expires_after_months` | `integer` | no | The credit expires this many months after payment. |
| `grant.applicability` | `object` | no | `{kind: metered}` or `{kind: prices, prices}`. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PUT "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/auto_topup" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "currency": "USD",
    "trigger": "threshold",
    "method": "fixed",
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "monthly_cap_minor": 2900,
    "grant": {
      "tax_treatment": "taxed_at_purchase"
    }
  }'
```
